title: Notation and domains of the open base-change square
statement: Fix the global finite field D, coefficient datum c and finite coefficient extension E. For four categories with tensor bifunctors T1,T2,T3,T4, functors F,F',G,H, a square isomorphism theta:G F'≅F H and tensor comparisons mu, Monoidality is the equation theta_(B tensor C);H(mu_F);mu_H = F'(mu_G);mu_F';T4(theta_B,theta_C). For open extension functors O,O', restrictions J,J', horizontal pullbacks H,A, maps gamma,gamma',beta, tensor comparisons mu_A,mu_H and sigma:AJ→HJ', OpenIdentityAt is H(gamma);beta;O'(mu_A;T(1,sigma)) = mu_H;T(beta,1);gamma'. For a SixFunctorCompactifiedSquare Q, specialize these to the actual intrinsic finite tensor and pullback and completed constructible tensor and pullback of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Define finiteTheta by the inverse canonical derived proper-square comparison and integralTheta by the two composition-normalized pullbacks and their geometric equality. FiniteMaps records the natural isomorphisms gamma,gamma',beta, with gamma inverses uniquely fixed by the open-unit adjunction transposes and beta inverse fixed by the canonical reverse open mate. IntegralMaps is the normalized open-factor assertion together with target tensor completion models [lem-sf-pf-open-factor-coherence]. Define M=O K, P=F L, Q=M tensor P, V=K tensor JP and W=AK tensor J'HP in both coefficient settings. FiniteDomains and IntegralDomains assert constructibility of these objects, all their displayed A,H,J,J' pullbacks and open extensions, and (integrally) the four proper images SM,SQ,S'HM,S'HQ. FiniteEquation and IntegralEquation are the corresponding OpenIdentityAt assertions, with the actual canonical tensor and square comparisons. All these existing definitions retain exactly their original Lean names, universes, signatures and bodies.

lean.statement:
def Monoidality {D₁ : Type u₁} {D₂ : Type u₂} {D₃ : Type u₃} {D₄ : Type u₄}
    [Category.{v₁} D₁] [Category.{v₂} D₂] [Category.{v₃} D₃] [Category.{v₄} D₄]
    (T₁ : D₁ × D₁ ⥤ D₁) (T₂ : D₂ × D₂ ⥤ D₂)
    (T₃ : D₃ × D₃ ⥤ D₃) (T₄ : D₄ × D₄ ⥤ D₄)
    (F : D₁ ⥤ D₂) (F' : D₃ ⥤ D₄) (G : D₁ ⥤ D₃) (H : D₂ ⥤ D₄)
    (theta : G ⋙ F' ≅ F ⋙ H)
    (muF : ∀ B C, F.obj (T₁.obj (B, C)) ≅ T₂.obj (F.obj B, F.obj C))
    (muF' : ∀ B C, F'.obj (T₃.obj (B, C)) ≅ T₄.obj (F'.obj B, F'.obj C))
    (muG : ∀ B C, G.obj (T₁.obj (B, C)) ≅ T₃.obj (G.obj B, G.obj C))
    (muH : ∀ B C, H.obj (T₂.obj (B, C)) ≅ T₄.obj (H.obj B, H.obj C)) : Prop
